title: Implement bounded provider-neutral numerical dense/sparse matrices and vectors with exact shape oracles
commitMessage: feat: introduce bounded provider-neutral numerical matrix contracts

contribution.summary: Deliver M3-W01-C02-T1 as a new standalone .NET 10 numerics package with immutable finite binary64 dense matrices and vectors, bounded scalar work, canonical sparse coordinate strategy, explicit approximate IR transport and copied provider-array interchange. Verify independent absent-contract RED, seventeen arithmetic/boundary GREEN tests, a real managed Math.NET 5.0.0 copy-bridge solve/residual, locked solution and existing Math regressions, plus local NuGet package dependency/assembly graph.
contribution.value: Math gains real provider-neutral approximate matrix/vector addition, multiplication and sparse storage with hand-checkable numerical oracles, shape/budget rejection and explicit IR/providercopy boundaries, without making third-party Math.NET types or packages public Math dependencies.
debtChanges: M3-W01-C02-T2 stays planned: qualify explicit rational-to-double conversion, advanced alias safety, sparse/provider strategy and optional-provider loading before C02 completion.
Only finite approximate binary64 is admitted. Exact rational IR is rejected rather than silently widened; no algebraic exactness or cross-platform floating bitwise equivalence is implied.
Managed Math.NET 5.0.0 appears only in a test-only adapter smoke, not in the new public dw.tools.math.numerics NuGet dependency graph.
Matrix storage is limited to 4096 cells; multiplication has a separate 65536-scalar-product quota. Nonfinite intermediate arithmetic is rejected.
No native BLAS, unexecuted RID, symbolic solver, AURA permission or external consumer adoption is claimed.
contribution.nextAction: After RS040 success, qualify M3-W01-C02-T2 boundaries: reported rational-to-binary64 precision loss, strict copy-versus-alias guarantees and no provider load-time dependency; close C02 only after independent RED/GREEN.

achievements.achievement: An independent compiled test observes the missing provider-neutral numerical matrix public contract before installing any numerical implementation.

Immutable, provider-free finite binary64 dense/sparse matrices and vectors implement shape-checked addition, multiplication, dot product, canonical sparse coordinates and approximate-only typed IR conversion with explicit budgets.
Seventeen independent numerical GREEN tests, managed Math.NET 5.0.0 copy-bridge solve/residual, prior regressions, locked build and verified local package demonstrate the qualified T1 scope.
The numerical matrix/vector contract and outcome task is qualified while provider loading, explicit exact-to-approximate policy and stronger aliasing remain for T2; neither C02 nor M3 is closed.
